title: 'Climb for the scrap of cloth' is a DC9 grace check explicitly re-triable on failure with no stated cost, so it can just be spammed until the die cooperates, making the difficulty meaningless.
where: Crow Perch (Vale of Ash), 'climb for the scrap of cloth'
